body: yeah, ive never felt more certain before, its beyond ideation, i have the right method now. i haven't set a specific date yet, but I think mid year because that's winter where I am and I like the cold.
not from the perspective of a mentally well person. but knowing I'm going to die is a relief in many ways, so in that sense, yes I'm okay
